history.body: Hi, I came across Pearl Residences. We’re considering a place for our own stay, but still comparing locations and budget. What area is it in, and roughly where do prices start?

Pearl Residences is in Seberang Jaya on Penang Mainland, with connectivity toward Sunway Carnival Mall and Chai Leng Park. The starting reference is about RM302k after the 8% rebate for an eligible podium-block category, based on the 14 Aug 2026 package; it’s a base-price reference, not a guaranteed all-in quote for a selected unit. For own stay, the standard Type A offers 900 sq ft, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony.

Thanks, that gives us a useful starting point. Seberang Jaya could work for us, and that price is in the range we’re exploring, though we’d need to understand the monthly costs before judging affordability. Is there an estimated maintenance fee?

The maintenance fee is RM0.18 per sq ft per month, inclusive of the sinking fund. For the 900 sq ft Type A, that works out to about RM162 a month—a useful baseline for your own-stay budget before factoring in financing. Selected clubhouse facilities are pay-per-use.
That’s helpful, thanks. We’re comparing a few places, and the loan payment will be the main monthly cost for us. I’ll check the numbers with my partner and get back to you if it looks workable.

That makes sense—the loan instalment is the key figure to check. The estimated RM162 maintenance fee gives you one part of the monthly cost, but not the full financing picture. If the numbers work for you both, I’d recommend viewing together so you can see whether the home feels right for your own stay before comparing further. There’s no need to decide on the spot.
